energy: Non-energy type. Cannot sustain energy the way Generators do. Need to manage output carefully and rest regularly. 20% of the population; designed to guide rather than produce.
work_approach: Natural advisor and guide. See systems and people clearly. Most effective when invited to share insight. Excellent at directing the work of others — not designed for sustained manual or repetitive output.
career_advice: Position yourself as the expert others invite in. Build a reputation and wait for the right recognition. Do not work harder to prove yourself — work more strategically and let your insight speak.
burnout_signal: Bitterness. Working without recognition or invitation, or trying to match Generator energy, leads to exhaustion and resentment.
pitfall: Over-working to match Generator output, accepting invitations from the wrong people, sharing insights before invited.
